Please, in the name of all things pure and good, DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT. I wish I had listened to all the reviews of people who experienced hair loss/damage after using this shampoo. I wish I had listened to my scalp that would always get red and irritated and flakey. I wish I had taken a warning after fishing out clumps of hair from my Tub Shroom after every wash, picking up chunks of hair scattered all around my apartment, and finding tons of hair on my wide tooth comb after one stroke through my once full head of hair. I only figured out I was shooting myself in the foot after a visit to my parents and I used their shampoo (no frills, from the local pharmacy) -- surprise, no hair loss! My biggest regret though: I wish I had taken before and after photos because I lost a significant amount of hair after switching to this shampoo. Please, please, please save yourself from a lot of pain, heartache, and hours figuring out creative ways to hide bald spots and stay as far away from this shampoo as possible!!!

ORIGINAL REVIEW: Only used the steamer once so far, but it took me 20 minutes just to remove the gel from ONE fingernail. I had to fix the accent nail on one hand when I chipped the nail, but didn't have the same color that the salon used. So, I was taking the color off the accent nail on the other hand so that my accent nails would match. Anyway, the plastic insert that holds the acetone doesn't fit snugly in the machine. It's plastic, so when you put it in the steamer, it pops up just a little. I added a little pressure to push it back down, but as soon as I took my hands off of it, it popped back up again. So, I don't know if it can actually make enough contact with the machine to get warm enough to create enough steam or not. I did have to refill the reservoir twice for that one nail though, and the polish crumbled off... never got moist. Ended up having to file the rest off and then buffing the nail. The lights on the machine aren't consistent either. When I first turned it on, the H (Heat) light came on. When the S (Steam) light came on, I put one finger in and curled it around the part that it shows in videos on-line, and I rested the remainder of the fingers across the top of the steamer. I noticed that the light kept bouncing back and forth between the H to the S. I checked the cord/plug to make sure everything was tight. No issues there. So, I don't think that's normal and feel like I've wasted my money. I was wary about this product due to all the negative reviews, but thought I'd take my chances. $30+ is a lot of money to "waste." Disappointed.

This is the worst eyebrow pencil I’ve tried at this price, and it’s even worse than the e.l.f. version that’s similar. I know that’s dramatic but the reason why I wanted to write this review is because I’m just so frustrated with the quality compared to the price. It’s just not okay! I’ve been using the nyx precision brow pencil, but this was a few dollars cheaper at ulta at the time and so I got it because the nyx one is like 10 bucks. My brows are the makeup I wear most consistently, so I’m always trying different brow pencils to try to cut down on the cost. But I go back to nyx every time. Maybe the morphe one is okay but it’s pretty hard and waxy so not really. Now I know the importance of the extra two dollars for the nyx. This pencil is so soft, it wears down so quickly and also because of how soft it is, it’s not precise at all. And it’s not pigmented either, so I end up using a larger amount of product because of that. To do both my brows, and I fill them in pretty lightly, I use about 1/8” of product each time. The nyx one I use less than 1/16” and it’s more pigmented. I would compare this to the elf one in terms of pigmentation and texture. Except the elf one is like $3. So at this price point I expected it to be way better than something that’s less than half its price. And after using it a few times, the spoolie end came off when I was trying to take the cap off to use it. The main body of the pencil cracked on that end. So now I have to use a spoolie from another brow pencil, good thing I have one. And this has just been on my desk, not banging around in a makeup bag or anything like that. So definitely don’t get this if you need to take it places it can’t handle it. This is one of the few times I would return a makeup product, it’s just so egregiously bad.
